Finance Commission is NOT a permanent body.

items: Exams frequently test whether Finance Commission recommendations are binding—remember they are advisory only.
Pay close attention to member numbers: it consists of a Chairman + FOUR members (total 5 members).
Do not confuse constitutional bodies with non-constitutional bodies like the Planning Commission.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Finance Commission is constituted periodically and is NOT a permanent body.
Recommendations made by the Finance Commission are advisory and NOT binding on the government.
Unlike the Finance Commission, the Planning Commission is NOT constitutional.
The composition of the Finance Commission is a Chairman plus FOUR members, not five.
